_comment: D13-F4: authentication decision matrices + every AuthenticationFailed code + permission predicates consumed by D-13 handlers + DRF failure body shapes.

apikey_authentication_consumed.failure_body: 401 {'Detail': 'Given API token is not valid'} — SAME message for: unknown token, revoked mt_, revoked dev-machine, non-member (token revoked first, then raise), expired/inactive APIToken. Deliberately opaque.
apikey_authentication_consumed.machine_token_branch: raw startswith 'mt_': hash -> lookup (select_related user, workspace, dev_machine); revoked? -> fail; machine revoked? -> fail; is_workspace_member? else token.revoke() + fail; bump last_used_at (NOT best-effort here — plain update); set request.auth_machine_token; return (user, raw_token_string). NOTE: request.auth for the mt_ branch is the RAW TOKEN STRING; for the APIToken branch request.auth is api_token.token (the stored string) — RunnerCreateEndpoint passes request.auth to deactivate_api_token.
apikey_authentication_consumed.no_header: missing X-Api-Key -> return None (falls through to next auth class or anonymous)
apikey_authentication_consumed.owner: api/middleware/api_authentication.py:20-76 — NOT D-13 owned; behavior recorded as consumed by the create endpoint and projects list
apikey_authentication_consumed.pitoken_branch: else APIToken lookup: (expired_at > now OR expired_at NULL) AND token == raw AND is_active; miss -> fail; bump last_used via save(update_fields=['last_used']); return (api_token.user, api_token.token)

drf_failure_shapes.AuthenticationFailed: HTTP 401 {'Detail': '<code>'} — verified against installed DRF (probe /tmp/d13_drf.py). Custom auth_exception_handler passes these through unchanged (only NotAuthenticated status + Throttled body are special-cased).
drf_failure_shapes.IsDesktopSession_denied: HTTP 403 with body == permission.message == {'error': 'desktop_session_required', 'Detail': 'This endpoint is available to the Pi Dash desktop app.'} (DRF renders message dict verbatim). Has_permission: user authenticated AND ee request_is_desktop(request).
drf_failure_shapes.NotAuthenticated: HTTP 401 {'Detail': 'Authentication credentials were not provided.'} (custom handler forces 401; verified message). Hit on IsAuthenticated views with no credentials.
drf_failure_shapes.Throttled_anon: HTTP 429 {'error_code': 5900, 'error_message': 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED'} via custom auth_exception_handler (exception.py). AnonRateThrottle 30/minute (settings/common.py:92-94) applies to EVERY view that inherits DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CLASSES (all D-13 views except the throttle_classes=[] list below) — but it throttles UNAUTHENTICATED requests only, so it only bites where anonymous callers get real responses: enroll, redeem, AND health (HealthEndpoint sets no throttle_classes — it inherits too). Session-authenticated calls on inheriting views (runners.py, pods.py, machine_commands web endpoints, projects, ticket, invite, revive) are never throttled by it. Views with throttle_classes=[] (refresh, self-revoke, create, desktop, machine-command-result) never throttle.
drf_failure_shapes.WWW_Authenticate: RunnerAccessTokenAuthentication/RunnerRefreshTokenAuthentication/MachineTokenAuthentication expose keyword 'Bearer' via authenticate_header -> 401 responses carry 'WWW-Authenticate: Bearer'.

machine_token_path.class: MachineTokenAuthentication (authentication.py:205-240). Used by MachineCommandResultEndpoint (D-13) and machine-session endpoints (D-14).
machine_token_path.last_used_at: best-effort: MachineToken.objects.filter(pk).update(last_used_at=now) wrapped in try/except Exception -> logger.debug, request CONTINUES (authentication.py:230-235). Differs from the mt_ branch inside RunnerAccessTokenAuthentication (:153), which is NOT wrapped.
machine_token_path.no_match: missing/empty Bearer, or raw not startswith 'mt_' -> return None
machine_token_path.success_shape: token lookup select_related(user, workspace, dev_machine) by token_hash

method: Decision matrices transcribed branch-by-branch from the cited lines in call order; DRF body shapes verified by executing the installed DRF exception handler (probe /tmp/d13_drf.py). No DB touched.

permission_predicates_consumed._authenticated_user_id: None unless user is not None and user.is_authenticated; else user.id (permissions.py:34-37)
permission_predicates_consumed.can_manage_runner: can_view_runner AND (PRIVATE: owner_id == user.id; non-PRIVATE (unreachable today): owner or workspace admin) (permissions.py:126-137). Used by: runner PATCH/DELETE/revoke.
permission_predicates_consumed.can_view_dev_machine: authenticated AND (PRIVATE: owner match; else False) (permissions.py:57-63). Used by _machine_is_in_workspace_scope.
permission_predicates_consumed.can_view_runner: authenticated AND (PRIVATE: owner match; else False) (permissions.py:70-76). Used by: runner detail/patch/delete/revoke, list filter.
permission_predicates_consumed.is_workspace_admin: workspace_role >= 20 (ROLE_ADMIN); ROLE: Admin=20, Member=15, Guest=5 (core/permissions.py:61-64). Used by: pod create, _can_manage_pod.
permission_predicates_consumed.is_workspace_member: WorkspaceMember.objects.filter(workspace_id, member=user, is_active=True).exists(); False for anonymous (core/permissions.py:28-34). Used by: nearly every D-13 endpoint + auth paths.
permission_predicates_consumed.owner_note: runner/services/permissions.py re-exports core membership helpers (core owned elsewhere); can_* live in runner/services/permissions.py:40-137
permission_predicates_consumed.runner_visible_to_user_q: anonymous -> Q(pk__isnull=True) i.e. NOTHING visible; authenticated -> Q(owner_id=user_id, visibility=PRIVATE). prefix kwarg for related traversal (permissions.py:40-54). Used by RunnerListEndpoint.

refresh_token_parse.behavior: extract Bearer via _bearer; missing -> return None; else request.auth_refresh_token = raw; return (None, None) — NO user, NO validation. All verification is row-locked in the view.

resolve_runner_for_run.behavior: runner = request.auth_runner or None -> False; run.runner_id None -> False; else UUID(str(run.runner_id)) == UUID(str(runner.id)) (UUID-normalized compare, authentication.py:243-254). Pure predicate, no DB.
resolve_runner_for_run.note: design.md §7.5 per-run authorization; consumed by run-lifecycle endpoints (D-14), pinned here as the F4 unit

runner_access_token_path.bearer_extract: _bearer: get_authorization_header split; must be exactly 2 parts, parts[0].lower()=='bearer'; else None. Empty header -> None -> authenticate returns None (authentication.py:46-53).

failure_codes_in_order: <decode code> (access_token_malformed | access_token_unknown_key | access_token_expired | access_token_invalid — re-raised as AuthenticationFailed(exc.code))
runner_revoked (runner.revoked_at set — per-request live check, design §5.4)
access_token_stale_rtg (int(payload.rtg or 0) < runner.refresh_token_generation - 1; note the -1 grace window)
force_refresh_required (RunnerForceRefresh row exists AND rtg < min_rtg)
jwt_branch.sets: request.auth_runner, request.auth_token_payload (= decoded payload); returns (runner.owner, None)

mt_branch.binding_rule: runner.owner_id == token.user_id AND runner.workspace_id == token.workspace_id REQUIRED. Then: token bound to a machine (dev_machine_id set) -> runner.dev_machine_id MUST equal it; token unbound (legacy host-label token) -> runner must have dev_machine_id None AND runner.host_label == token.host_label. ANY binding violation -> runner_not_bound_to_machine_token.
failure_codes_in_order: membership_revoked (non-member; token.revoke() called FIRST, then raise)
runner_id_required (no URL runner_id and no/blank X-Runner-Id header)
dev_machine_revoked (runner's machine revoked — second site, same code)
mt_branch.runner_id_source: URL resolver_match.kwargs['runner_id'] wins; else request.headers['X-Runner-Id'].strip(); blank -> None (authentication.py:167-180)
mt_branch.sets: MachineToken last_used_at bump (NOT best-effort — plain .update, :153); request.auth_runner, request.auth_machine_token, request.auth_token_payload = {sub, uid, wid, machine_token}; returns (token.user, None)

runner_access_token_path.note: membership is NOT re-checked on the JWT branch (bounded by access-token TTL); it IS checked on the mt_ branch per request.
